alt: 想用黏紙惡作劇捉弄別人的人，反而讓自己的鞋子黏住，原先設計的把戲落到自己身上。
scene_prompt: 作法自斃 means being harmed by one's own harmful scheme. Gentle modern harmless-prank scene. An older teenager intended to trick a friend with an unnamed sticky paper mat at a doorway, but now HIS OWN shoe is visibly stuck to that mat and he cannot step away without taking off the shoe. He looks embarrassed and surprised; the unharmed friend walks past safely, calmly pointing at the obvious reversal. A small pencil thought-memory bubble shows only the intended image of the FRIEND's different-colored shoe on that same mat, linking bad intention and self-inflicted result. No glue recipes, tools, hazardous chemicals, falls or injury; no bullying celebration or laughing crowd. Normal anatomy, sticky shoe not trapped body.
